verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is indirect: monday.com offers a GraphQL API and SDKs for interacting with workflows, plus granular read scopes like `boards:read`, so a user could in principle script their own data extraction. Nothing documents a native bulk export, open file formats, or an offboarding path. Missing for 10: a documented full-account data export, explicit open-format outputs (e.g. CSV/JSON/XLSX dumps), coverage of all data types (files, updates, automations), and independent or hands-on corroboration of leaving with complete data.
